comment: Fresh context-free translations of the five transparent specification/proof pairs on the current ten-row review surface.

literalApplicantOptimalCollegeAssignment.tex_statement: For arbitrary applicant and college types, a natural quota for every college, real-valued applicant and college score functions, and a many-to-one assignment mu, the proposition literalApplicantOptimalCollegeAssignment_iff_source_definitionSpec for those data holds.

For arbitrary applicant and college types, a natural quota for every college, real-valued applicant and college score functions, and a many-to-one assignment mu, define literalApplicantOptimalCollegeAssignment_iff_source_definitionSpec to be the equivalence between literal applicant optimality of mu and the conjunction that mu respects the quotas, mu has no literal replacement-pair instability, and for every quota-feasible literally stable assignment nu and every applicant a, the value to a of nu.app_match(a) is at most the value to a of mu.app_match(a).

theorem1_stable_marriage_exists.tex_statement: The closed proposition theorem1_stable_marriage_existsSpec holds; after its transparent expansion, this says that for finite types M and W with decidable equality and real-valued score functions v_M : M -> W -> R and v_W : W -> M -> R, equal cardinalities and strict profiles in which every cross-side pair is acceptable imply the existence of a complete two-sided assignment with no mutually improving pair.

theorem1_stable_marriage_existsSpec.tex_statement: For finite types M and W with decidable equality and real-valued score functions v_M : M -> W -> R and v_W : W -> M -> R, define theorem1_stable_marriage_existsSpec to mean: if M and W have equal cardinality and the two score profiles are strict with every cross-side pair acceptable, then there exists a two-sided assignment mu that is complete and has no pair m,w who both strictly prefer one another to their assigned partners.

theorem2_applicant_optimality.tex_statement: The closed proposition theorem2_applicant_optimalitySpec holds; after its transparent expansion, this says that for finite applicant and college types with decidable equality, natural college quotas, real-valued applicant and college score functions, and a strict college-admissions domain hdomain, there exists s : SourceWaitingListState satisfying SourceReachable(quota,val_applicant,val_college,hdomain.2.1,s) and no SourceActive applicant, and every state s satisfying those same conditions has applicantOptimalCollegeAssignment for sourceAssignmentView(quota,val_college,hdomain.2.1,s).

theorem2_applicant_optimalitySpec.tex_statement: For finite applicant and college types with decidable equality, natural college quotas, and real-valued applicant and college score functions, define theorem2_applicant_optimalitySpec to mean that for every strict college-admissions domain proof hdomain: first, there exists s of type SourceWaitingListState such that SourceReachable(quota,val_applicant,val_college,hdomain.2.1,s) and no applicant a satisfies SourceActive(quota,val_applicant,val_college,hdomain.2.1,s,a); and second, for every SourceWaitingListState s, those same reachability and inactivity conditions imply applicantOptimalCollegeAssignment(quota,val_applicant,val_college, sourceAssignmentView(quota,val_college,hdomain.2.1,s)).

unstableCollegeAssignment_iff_source_def.tex_statement: For arbitrary applicant and college types, real-valued applicant and college score functions, and a consistent many-to-one assignment mu, the proposition unstableCollegeAssignment_iff_source_definitionSpec for those data holds.

For arbitrary applicant and college types, real-valued applicant and college score functions, and a consistent many-to-one assignment mu, define the proposition unstableCollegeAssignment_iff_source_definitionSpec to be the equivalence between unstableCollegeAssignment of mu and replacementPairCollegeInstability of mu, with the same two score functions.

unstableMarriage_iff_source_definition.tex_statement: For arbitrary types M and W, real-valued score functions v_M : M -> W -> R and v_W : W -> M -> R, and a two-sided assignment mu, the proposition unstableMarriage_iff_source_definitionSpec(v_M,v_W,mu) holds.

unstableMarriage_iff_source_definitionSp.tex_statement: For arbitrary types M and W, real-valued score functions v_M : M -> W -> R and v_W : W -> M -> R, and a two-sided assignment mu, define the proposition unstableMarriage_iff_source_definitionSpec(v_M,v_W,mu) to be the equivalence between unstableMarriage(v_M,v_W,mu) and the existence of m : M and w : W such that valM(v_M,m,mu.m_match(m)) < v_M(m,w) and valW(v_W,w,mu.w_match(w)) < v_W(w,m).

prompt_summary: Translate each declaration from the Lean statement alone, without paper context.
Preserve every visible carrier, instance, function, premise, named predicate application, implication or equivalence direction, runner application, and conclusion.
Do not replace a visible predicate or runner with a source label or proof-route summary.
